content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: Pandas 3.0 infers ordinary string collections as the dedicated `str` dtype by default rather than NumPy `object`. Code that checks `dtype == "object"` for text may therefore break after an upgrade. Choose the dtype deliberately and review missing-value semantics.

content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

items = pd.Series(["Tea", None])
print(items.dtype)
print(items.isna().tolist())
print(pd.api.types.is_string_dtype(items.dtype))
content_blocks.expected_output: On Pandas 3.x, the inferred dtype is `str`, missingness is `[False, True]`, and `is_string_dtype` is True. On Pandas 2.x, the inferred dtype may be `object`; compare against the installed version.
